notes: Merged from two passes that agree on the nine requirements' tables, anchors or selectors and values (users 3 and 49, profiles 3 and 49, case 61, article 7, two notifications plus the pair bound) and on all nine dispositions (eight kept, the article title repaired the same way by both). disagreement: sql of the two user requirements: B adds the email beside the anchor; dropped (logged in each). disagreement: org_id = 1 on the case and on the article: A tests it, B does not; kept, as the benchmark checks test it (logged in each). disagreement: opened_by = 39 on the case: B tests it from policy 3.1, A leaves it untested because every one of the 60 seed cases has opened_by = opened_for; kept per policy and the batch 14 precedent (logged in the requirement); drop it if the create tool proves to set opened_by on its own. disagreement: notification selectors: A by the anchored case id, B by the account-number join; kept A's (logged in each). disagreement: form of the pair bound: B repeats type and status in selector and cells; kept A's shape (logged). Policy conflict a reviewer should know of: this policy version restricts the admin role ('Must not perform routine HR case work') and the acting user Karen Watkins is an admin; the benchmark's checks assume she creates the case, article and notifications, and this file follows that prior (a GDPR remediation after an access review is read as not routine). The user_role table mirrors user.role for both users (Tabitha role_id 3 agent, Cheryl role_id 2 manager); the request's 'system role' is taken to be user.role, which the policy enumerates and the benchmark tests; no listed tool writes user_role, so it is left untested rather than invented. Both hr_profile stays are what the request forbids changing, so they are requirements, not invented invariants. 'Nothing else in this tenant should change' is a generic invariant measured as collateral change, not written as stays. No boundary stays: every name, email, service and group resolves to one row and no case has a near-match account number.
